channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Hyderabad Tragedy, Man Stabbed in Qutbullapur, Relatives Accused in Murder Attempt
item.description: Hyderabad crime news: A man was stabbed in Qutbullapur under Jagadgirigutta police limits. Relatives accused in attempted murder after a family dispute in Alwyn Colony.

item.title: Vaibhav Suryavanshi receives PM Rashtriya Bal Puraskar from President Droupadi Murmu, BCCI congratulates
item.description: The Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar is India’s highest civilian honour for individuals aged five to 18, instituted to recognise exceptional achievements across diverse fields like art and culture, innovation, science and technology, social service, sports and instances of bravery.

item.title: Vijay Hazare Trophy: Kohli, Pant hit fifties as Delhi edge Gujarat by seven runs in thrilling clash
item.description: Virat Kohli and Rishabh Pant struck contrasting fifties before Gujarat collapsed in the closing stages as Delhi claimed a narrow seven-run victory in their Elite Group D encounter of the Vijay Hazare Trophy

item.title: Aster Prime Hospital, Ameerpet, Safeguards 1,000 Young Athletes with First Aid and Health Screening at Khelo Bharat Event
item.description: The initiative was organised in coordination by Sri P. Sunil Kumar, National President, Abhinava Bharatam Society and MY BHARAT, Hyderabad, and was aimed at ensuring the health, safety and overall well-being of children participating in the event.

item.title: The Under-19 Rajiv Gandhi All India Cricket All India Cricket Championship competitions will begin from January 7.
item.description: He informed that the cricket championship matches will be held from January 7 to January 10 at LB Stadium, Vijay Anand Ground at Attapur, and Amberpet Water Works Ground.

item.title: Hyderabad Tragedy, 3-Year-Old Dies, Another Child Critical In-House Fire Caused by AC Blast in Kachiguda
item.description: Hyderabad tragedy: A 3-year-old child died, and another was critically injured in a house fire caused by an AC blast in Kachiguda’s Sunder Nagar. Police begin probe.

item.title: “If not today, then tomorrow” Raja Singh Signals Return to BJP, says ‘I Will Come Back, When?
item.description: Hyderabad: MLA Raja Singh has once again hinted at his return to the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), saying that it is only a matter of time before he goes back to his “home.” His remarks have triggered fresh political buzz in Telangana, with speculation intensifying about his re-entry into the party. item.title: Hyderabad Becomes Mega City After GHMC Merger, Says Commissioner R.V. Karnan
item.description: Hyderabad becomes a mega city after 27 municipalities merge into GHMC, expanding its area to 2,053 sq km. Commissioner R.V. Karnan outlines new zones and offices.

item.title: Muslim Empowerment Depends on Political Power, Says Shabbir Ali in Hyderabad
item.description: Muslim empowerment depends on political power and representation, says Shabbir Ali in Hyderabad, highlighting 4% reservation benefits and Congress commitment to inclusive governance.

item.title: Salman Khan Summoned by Court in Pan Masala Ad Case, Forensic Test Ordered
item.description: Salman Khan asked to appear before Kota Consumer Court in pan masala ad case. Court orders forensic test of his signature; next hearing scheduled for January 20.
